svg.title: Two vectors tail to tail, the angle between them, and u − v
svg.desc: The vectors u and v start at the same point, with the angle θ between them marked at that point. A third side, u − v, runs from the tip of v to the tip of u and closes a triangle. The law of cosines on this triangle, with sides of length ‖u‖, ‖v‖, and ‖u − v‖, gives the formula for cos θ.
